Name: Elliott in Mermaid Pendant Earring
Author: faerisami
TagLine: Just what the title says, Elliott uses the Mermaid Pendant as an earring!
Description:
Based off of his old portraits where he had his ears pierced. Credit for the idea/headcannon to Pajama-Han on Reddit!

I'm just an artist with access to google and an Eliott enthusiast - by no way a modder, so only install it if you are currently married to him. Overwrite the Elliott.xnb in your StardewValley\Content\Portraits folder (don't forget to make a backup of the original first!). Also included in the .zip is the standalone earring, feel free to place it or edit it over the other bachelors/ettes if you feel like it!
